h: Prayer That Yields to the Divine Will

p: do not continue to speak to Me," etc.
And Rashi explained, from the Sifrei:
is stored away for you," etc.;
And in its plain sense it is
Did he need to eat of its fruit,
let me enter the land," etc.
And on this He said to him,
as they said in the Gemara there:
as though you had performed them."
כֵּיוָן שֶׁרְצוֹן מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
since the desire of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
מַה יּוֹעִיל לוֹ עַל זֶה הַשָּׂכָר
what would the reward help him in this?
only the fulfillment of the mitzvos,
not the reward of the mitzvos;
not for the sake of receiving a reward.
"and that they should not press the End";
and they would accomplish through their prayer
with Rabbi Chiya and his sons
and about this was the oath
that they should not press the End.
And so is the meaning here:
"Much is yours in My hand for Olam HaBa"
that is, in return for this,
that you not press with prayer;
for had he pressed with prayer,
Moshe Rabbeinu would have had the power
but the will of Hashem Yisbarach was
that Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, remain
he would bring in the generation of the wilderness too in the future;
"And he came with the heads of the people," etc.;
And this is why He said, "Enough for you":
there is much in My hand for you for Olam HaBa,
not in return for the mitzvos,
that you not pray at length;
"do not continue to speak to Me"
And this is likewise the intent in the oaths
that Yisrael should not go up as a wall
and should not rebel against the nations of the world.
why is an oath needed for this?
Since if it will not be the time
and the will of Hashem Yisbarach,
it will certainly not be in their power
for Hashem is not in your midst,
so that you not be struck down," etc.
"that they should not go up as a wall"
that is, even if it occurs to them
that they are worthy of redemption;
אֲנִי חוֹמָה זוֹ תּוֹרָה וְכוּלֵּי (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים ח, י)
"'I am a wall' (Shir HaShirim 8:10) — this is Torah," etc.;
אִם חוֹמָה הוּא (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים ח, ט)
"if he stands his words firm like a wall,"
and I shall stand good deeds firm like a wall."
And this is "that they should not go up as a wall":
that they should not insist on going up
by the power of the wall,
even when they see that they are worthy
and good deeds like a wall;
that they should not go up as a wall.
And "that they should not rebel against the nations of the world":
the wickedness of the nations has grown so great
עַד שֶׁרְאוּיִם לְהִגָּאֵל עַל יְדֵי זֶה
that they deserve to be redeemed because of it;
since the End has not been revealed,
and as long as it has not arisen in His will,
there is none among us who knows
whether they are worthy of redemption on their part,
and likewise whether the measure is full
of the nations of the world,
for the Holy One, blessed is He, does not exact punishment
until the time of its sending away

p: And so is the order of the parshiyos:
and it is the beginning of Torah she'b'al peh;
as is written in the holy Zohar
which is also of the attribute of Malchus,
"They shall fear You with the sun"
"Even if the master of dreams, etc.,
one should not hold himself back
at the beginning of the tefillah (Tehillim 51:17):
and in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 260b):
"Moshe was the beginning in the world," etc.
and at the beginning of creation
"The conclusion is the King Mashiach," etc.
That is, the beginning of Torah she'b'al peh,
the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
הָיָה גַּם כֵּן עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ
"and the conclusion is the King Mashiach,"
all of the Torah she'b'al peh
that can be revealed in this world.
"And in the second Luchos I am giving you
for this is the purpose of the exiles:
from the nations the root of life,
which is the Torah she'b'al peh
this vitality for the opposite purpose.
"The Holy One, blessed is He, exiled
that converts be added to them";
that they will extract from them.
And when they have extracted from them
all of the Torah she'b'al peh,
which corresponds to the attribute of Malchus,
a revelation of Torah she'b'al peh,
as has been explained many times.
